lines.text: Sennacherib of Assyria captured Judah's fortified cities, then sent the Rabshakeh with a great army from Lachish to Jerusalem.
The Rabshakeh stopped by the aqueduct of the upper pool, and Eliakim, Shebna and Joah went out to him.
The Rabshakeh said Judah was trusting in Babylon, a splintered reed of a staff that pierces the hand of anyone who leans on it.
The officials asked him to speak Aramaic, but he stood and called out loudly in Hebrew to the people on the wall.
He asked whether the gods of Hamath and Arpad delivered Samaria, but the people stayed silent because Ahaz had commanded it.
